title: Artificial Finance: How AI Thinks About Money

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses to 14 financial decision-making questions against empirical human survey data from 53 countries using hierarchical clustering and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to identify which national or cultural profile the models most closely resemble.

Administering lottery and intertemporal choice questions to calculate specific economic parameters, such as expected value alignment, present bias (β), and long-term impatience (δ), assessing how models deviate from normative economic reasoning.
